claims.claim: After exact HEAD and clean-state checks, each materialized clone creates a new empty subject-local .git/aios directory. The composition regression confirms the control sentinel is absent and the transient subject is removed on cleanup.

The composition regression runs an unchanged repository-relative command in the isolated subject; it creates and uses a .git/aios leaf with mkdir() and no parents=True, then confirms successful completion, exact HEAD, and clean tracked state.

The only production edit is directory creation at the existing materialization boundary. Command execution, RuntimeCompletion, subject-integrity checks, TEMP isolation, cleanup, and lifecycle code remain unchanged.
